channels.display: A revisable user-visible output canvas denoised by the model.
channels.facts: Runtime-owned protected facts are read-only to the model.
channels.tct: The Typed Cognitive Tensor is fixed-capacity physical storage with dynamic logical occupancy for continuous cognitive state.

architecture.generation: CID is diffusion-native: visible output and cognitive state are iteratively refined instead of being committed only by a conventional left-to-right autoregressive loop.
architecture.grounding: TCT cells have stable logical cell IDs independent of physical slots and may carry typed roles, lifecycle state, anchors, and cognitive links.
architecture.interaction: External source I/O can remain in flight while model denoising steps continue; arriving observations are projected back as percepts and can revise TCT state and display output.
architecture.model_responsibility: The model predicts cognitive/display updates, information needs, learned lifecycle/allocation proposals, and convergence-related signals subject to runtime gates.
architecture.runtime_responsibility: The CID runtime owns protected facts, source schemas, bindings, external jobs, cache/provenance/freshness state, asynchronous scheduling, and hard safety/lifecycle invariants.

method.description: A diffusion-native model/runtime method for continuous asynchronous tool-augmented reasoning.
method.name: Continuous Interaction Diffusion
method.purpose: Allow a diffusion language model to keep refining cognition and visible output while external I/O is in flight, then incorporate arriving observations without restarting generation.

model.name: CID-v1
model.relationship: CID-v1 is a diffusion language model trained to operate with the Continuous Interaction Diffusion (CID) architecture and runtime.
